name: uams-web/baptisthealthuamsgme
description: Development-only Composer file for the Baptist Health UAMS GME theme. It declares the supported PHP floor, the development PHP and the test tooling; the theme itself loads no Composer package.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the test suites (the Unit suite only until an Integration suite exists).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
